parts.text: (ii) • Place the sliding contact C at a distance l = 20.0 cm from P . • Measure, and record in Table 2.1, the potential difference V across the length l of the resistance wire. • Calculate, and record in Table 2.1, the resistance R of 20.0 cm of the resistance wire.
